description: Add uptime monitoring docs, Vertex AI retry logic, rate limiting on auth endpoints, runbook, and architecture decision record
steps: Create infra/uptime-checks.md documenting: recommended UptimeRobot/Checkly setup, endpoints to monitor (https://api.syrabit.ai/health, https://syrabit.ai, https://api.syrabit.ai/api/content/boards), and alert channels (email, Slack/Discord). Commit: 'docs: add external uptime monitoring configuration'

In apps/backend/app/services/ai/vertex_client.py, add a stream_generate_with_retry method following the exact pattern from sarvam_client.py: retry on 5xx or timeout, max 1 retry, 0.3s delay. The method should be an async generator that wraps stream_generate(). Commit: 'feat: add Vertex AI stream retry logic for resilience'

In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py, add IP-based rate limiting to login (10/min) and signup (5/min) endpoints. Use the existing Upstash Redis client via get_redis(). Pattern: store counter with key like 'auth_limit:{endpoint}:{ip}:{minute_bucket}', increment, expire after 60s. Return 429 if exceeded. Wrap in try/except so if Redis unavailable, skip limiting. Commit: 'feat: add IP-based rate limiting on login and signup endpoints'

Create docs/RUNBOOK.md with sections: restart backend (az containerapp revision restart), rotate API keys (Sarvam, Vertex, Razorpay via Azure KeyVault), rollback deploy, check logs (az containerapp logs show), manually trigger CI/CD (gh workflow run), emergency contacts/escalation. Commit: 'docs: add operational runbook'

Create docs/ARCHITECTURE.md as an ADR documenting decisions: Vertex AI for English (Gemini best English reasoning), Sarvam AI for Assamese (native Indic model), Cloudflare Edge Worker (bot protection, CORS, rate limiting, global edge), Azure Container Apps (auto-scale, managed infra, KeyVault), Cloudflare Pages for frontend (global CDN, instant deploys), MongoDB Atlas (flexible schema for chat history), Upstash Redis (serverless, HTTP-based, global). Commit: 'docs: add architecture decision record'
acceptance_criteria: infra/uptime-checks.md exists with all 3 endpoints and alert channel info
vertex_client.py has stream_generate_with_retry method matching sarvam_client.py pattern
auth.py login and signup endpoints have rate limiting with correct limits (10/min login, 5/min signup)
docs/RUNBOOK.md exists with all required sections
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md exists with all 7 technology decisions documented
Each change committed separately with descriptive messages on feat/production-hardening branch

Run python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py').read())" to validate Python syntax
Verify git log shows all commits on the branch
findings: All 5 steps completed with individual commits. Python files validated via AST parsing. Upstash Redis calls in rate limiter are synchronous (no await) as required by upstash_redis HTTP client.
